_comment: GR00T schema for the TMR station. This file is PURELY DESCRIPTIVE - nothing in LABS
validates it against the data, it is copied verbatim into the exported dataset. Get
it wrong and every downstream consumer mis-slices the vectors silently.
The real layout is a flat concat in this order:
state  = observer_devices order, then the topics within each device
with per-topic width set by which handler in lerobot_mcap_reader.py fires:
JointState    -> len(name), POSITION ONLY (velocity is never read)
The offsets below assume 7 arm joints and 1 gripper joint per side. VERIFY after the
first conversion and correct this file to match reality:
NOTE: example_station's modality.json is wrong in exactly this way - it declares 56
state dims by assuming measured_joint_states also yields 7 velocity dims, but
_handle_joint_state reads .position only. Do not copy its arithmetic.
